connector.name: Unreal Engine MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Unreal Engine 5 with 23 tools for game development automation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package unreal-engine-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chir24 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging level: debug, info, warn, error (default: info)

env.name: MCP_ROUTE_STDOUT_LOGS
env.description: Route standard output to standard error to avoid protocol corruption (default: true)

env.name: UE_PROJECT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to your Unreal .uproject file

env.name: MCP_AUTOMATION_HOST
env.description: Automation bridge WebSocket host (default: 127.0.0.1). Set to 0.0.0.0 for LAN access (requires MCP_AUTOMATION_ALLOW_NON_LOOPBACK=true)

env.name: MCP_AUTOMATION_ALLOW_NON_LOOPBACK
env.description: SECURITY: Allow binding to non-loopback addresses (e.g., 0.0.0.0) for LAN access. Only enable if you understand the security implications. (default: false)

env.name: MCP_AUTOMATION_CLIENT_MODE
env.description: Run as client connecting to UE (false) or server listening for UE (true) (default: false)

env.name: MCP_AUTOMATION_USE_TLS
env.description: Use wss:// for the automation bridge client connection (default: false)

env.name: MCP_AUTOMATION_MAX_MESSAGES_PER_MINUTE
env.description: Max inbound automation bridge messages per minute before disconnect (default: 600)

env.name: MCP_AUTOMATION_MAX_AUTOMATION_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE
env.description: Max inbound automation request messages per minute before disconnect (default: 120)
